newsitem.title: NORWAY: Braathens Q1 net profit up 120 pct.
newsitem.headline: Braathens Q1 net profit up 120 pct.

text.p: NOTE - Full name of Norwegian airliner is Braathens SAFE. It said the purchase of 50 percent of stock in Swedish carrier Transwede Airways was included in the figures from September 1996, but no pro-forma comparatives including Transwede were made for first quarter results.
For comparison with the first quarter of last year, the airliner said it had provided separate 1997 figures for the group excluding Transwede.

The Oslo Bourse, however, compared the first-quarter 1997 figures including Transwede with first-quarter figures in 1996 excluding the Swedish airliner. By this comparison, first-quarter net profits this year were 39 million crowns rather than 44 million.
